Title: Azure Container Registry is now generally available in UAE North region

Body.Content:
Azure Container Registry is now generally available in the UAE North region, bringing the total number of Azure regions that it's available in to 33. See the list of all regions where Azure Container Registry is available and where it's coming next.

Azure Container Registry allows you to build, store, and manage images and artifacts for all types of container deployments. To learn more, read the Container Registry product page and documentation.
